system.description: Chessmaster god of change, hope, trickery, magic and scheming who uses followers as pieces in a vast unseen design, often lifting them to power along the way.
system.summary: Chessmaster god of change, hope, trickery, magic and scheming who uses followers as pieces in a vast unseen design, often lifting them to power along the way.
commandments: Keep plans flexible and adapt whenever needed.
Alter what displeases you in yourself, freely using sorcery.
Pursue your own aims and seize control of your fate.
directives: Exploit change for your own gain and never waste it.
Always hold a further goal and find reasons to change things.
Harness forces greater than yourself; turn the world on itself.
Conceal your aims behind many lies and act unpredictably.
Think hard before acting on rage, fear or love; chances are rare.

cults.name: The Player's Club
cults.summary: Elite gamblers who engineer wars, plagues and crises in advance and then wager on how they play out.

cults.name: Illuminati
cults.summary: Mostly recent 'ancient' secret societies playing at hidden power, sometimes used as pawns by real conspiracies and occasionally becoming genuinely important.
